firm_data.firm_name: Bee Ready Fishbein Hatter & Donovan, LLP
firm_data.firm_description: Bee Ready Fishbein Hatter & Donovan, LLP is a law firm with over twenty attorneys, providing personal service to clients in three primary practice groups: labor/municipal/employment, litigation, and real estate. The firm's attorneys appear at all levels of state and federal courts.
notable_facts: Founded in 1980 by Peter A. Bee.
The firm has three primary practice groups: Labor/Municipal/Employment, Litigation, and Real Estate.

email.subject: AI for Bee Ready Fishbein Hatter & Donovan, LLP
email.body:
Hi Laura,

Bee Ready Fishbein Hatter & Donovan has built real strength across labor and employment, litigation, and real estate since 1980. With over twenty attorneys serving clients at all court levels, you're competing on expertise, not headcount.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to meet regional firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by Mineola on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
